I'm checking whether the docs mention Unity at all, and they don't. The only plugin they name is the WordPress one planned in F131, and I'm weighing whether to cite that plan's path as the closing doc reference.

I'm settling on which doc to cite for the WordPress plugin mention, and I'm leaning toward the F131 plan path rather than src/docs/TODO.md. I'll keep the answer short and offer the user a few choices.

No, the docs don't mention Unity or any game engine. I found no Unity plugin, SDK or package in them.

The only plugin the docs name is a planned WordPress plugin for putting the chat on any website. It is in the plan for F131, not shipped.

For a game, the docs point to the hosts. An agent can run behind an HTTP API (`SessionEndpoints`) or behind an MCP server (`McpHost`). A Unity project could call either from its own code, but the docs don't describe that.

`src/docs/plans/F131-the-chat-on-any-website.md`

choices.label: Show me the hosts
choices.why: The HTTP API and MCP server are how other software reaches an agent.

choices.label: Explain the WordPress plugin plan
choices.why: The one plugin the docs name, and its status.

choices.label: Tell me about your project
choices.why: Describe the game and what you want the agent to do, and I'll check what the docs support.
